notes.title: Get the game for free (4/18 ~ 4/26)
notes.content:
You can get the game for free for 8 days from 4/18.
Please play this opportunity!

notes.title: To customers during the sale period (4/4 ~ 4/18)
notes.content:
Thank you for your purchase and consideration.

This time, we made a big sale, but decided to distribute it for free for a limited time. It also announces and starts nearby.
If you want to get the game during that period, please wait until then or return it now.

Thank you.
